title: Stockfish, But It Loses 50 ELO Every Move
summary: 'Tired Fish': Stockfish starts at 3600 and loses 50 Elo every move it makes (~2600 by move 20, ~1600 by move 40). Player (white) plays a solid, symmetrical, drawish London/Colle-style setup (c3 vs ...c5, Nf3, Ne5 ideas) to survive into the late game, trades pieces, and once the engine weakens grabs a free rook, promotes and gives ladder mate to win game 1.
rules: After every move the bot makes, it loses 50 Elo.
Official site: -50 after each bot move, floor 0 (at 0 plays random moves); strength from bucket floor(r/200)*200.
win_condition: Checkmate the bot. Video: won game 1.
